name: stabilitea
description: Local-only personal finance app: monthly budget vs. actual, rollovers, and savings.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @stabilitea/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,yellow "npm run dev -w @stabilitea/api" "npm run start -w @stabilitea/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @stabilitea/shared && npm run build -w @stabilitea/api && npm run build -w @stabilitea/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @stabilitea/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:push && npm run build
